How to use this calculator

  1. Enter agreed vehicle price, estimated residual value, cash due at signing and the remaining inputs.
  2. Select Calculate to see the answer and its breakdown.
  3. Keep a scenario, change an input and compare the results.

Use consistent units and check the assumptions below before applying the result.

How auto lease is calculated

The estimate subtracts the down payment and amortizes the balance over equal monthly payments. Program fees, insurance and eligibility rules are included only when a separate input explicitly provides them. Formula: This estimate applies fixed-payment amortization to the net amount financed. Use the displayed details to inspect the intermediate amounts and replace example assumptions with terms from your own quote or records.

Frequently asked questions

Auto Lease Calculator: what does the result include?

It is the loan payment and any explicit premium included in the selected calculator. Property tax, homeowners insurance, maintenance and association costs may add to it.

Auto Lease Calculator: which assumptions matter most?

No. The user-entered rates and fees are assumptions; confirm program rules and any required insurance or funding charges with the lender.
